steps.title: Booting safe mode
lines: Ensure the console is powered off
Keep these buttons held down until the console boots in the next step
While still holding the other buttons, press the power button

steps.title: Updating the System
lines: You should boot into a "system update" screen. Click OK and accept the prompts
If there's no working internet connection configured on your 3ds, you'll have the option to set one up now
When the update finishes, the console will automatically turn off
